title: Final Energy Correction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the second order energy correction E^{(2)}.

title: Perturbation Hamiltonian
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and write the perturbation Hamiltonian H'.

title: Eigenfunction and Eigenvalue
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive and state the eigenfunctions and eigenvalues of the unperturbed Hamiltonian.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly evaluate the integral involved in calculating the matrix elements of the perturbation.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the perturbation terms and energy corrections.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that could simplify the problem.
